This idea has been suggested before and I'll say the same thing I said last time: I look at people's comment history to verify if they're honest when I see them giving out advice, particularly when claiming to work in a certain industry or be from a certain place, etc.

If someone makes a post claiming to be a surgeon in an obvious attempt to give their comment credibility that it wouldn't have otherwise, I'll look at their post history to see if they recently claimed to be a lawyer and before that, a chef and before that, a real Nigerian prince, etc.

Being able to see someone's post history is too useful to get rid of. Plus, it's also the easiest way to verify if someone is a troll just trying to bait you.
